summary.name: Beekeeper Studio
summary.one_liner: Beekeeper Studio is an open source SQL client and database manager for MySQL, Postgres, SQLite, SQL Server, Firebird and other databases.
use_cases: browse and edit database tables in a spreadsheet-like view
write and run SQL queries with autocomplete
connect to a remote database over SSH or SSL
import CSV into a new table
export query results or tables to CSV, JSON, JSONL or SQL
share saved database connections with a team
summary.what_it_does: Beekeeper Studio is a SQL client supporting MySQL, Postgres, SQLite, SQL Server, Firebird and more. It includes a SQL editor with syntax highlighting and auto-complete for tables, plus saved queries and connections that can be organized into folders. Users can browse and edit table data in a spreadsheet-like interface, edit cells directly in query results, and edit JSON with syntax checking. The table creator supports adding indexes and foreign keys, and data can be imported from or exported to CSV, JSON, JSONL and SQL. Connections can use SSL or SSH tunneling, and an AI Shell can connect a database to an AI model.
notable: Open source with a feature-full community edition under an OSI approved license
Built-in AI Shell that can explore schema and run SQL with permission
Team cloud workspace that syncs connections and saved queries across devices
Edit JSON stored in TEXT columns with highlighting and syntax checking
caveats: Cloud sync and team folders are part of a cloud workspace feature; the page does not give its pricing
